description: I do not live a hard life , I focus on ease and stability. #selfdiscovery #selflove #selfmastery #designyourlife
transcript: I do not live a hard life. I do not live a frantic life. I do not live a chaotic life because I do not have to. I get to choose the life that I want to lead. And within that, I don't focus on the things that don't work for me. I do not work focused on things that are too difficult. I focus on what aligns with me, what I'm great at, and I amplify those things.
